propositions: The bridge was operating in continuous mode via self-re-dispatch; RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS config was flipped to false to free the runner and require scheduled execution instead
The three-entry 40-minute cron schedule in reconcile-bridge.yml must be replaced with a single hourly entry at 23 * * * * (off-:00 to avoid GitHub scheduler contention)

The CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm is structurally unfirable at hourly cadence (threshold=1, period=3600 means at most one failed pass per bucket); it must be retuned to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect sustained failures across two consecutive hours
Cadence tests, cron literals, and documentation must be updated from 40-minute to hourly references; the canary remains 2-hourly with its 4-hour window (3x cadence floor: 3h < 4h)
terraform apply is required to deploy the monitoring_bridge.tf alarm retune; Terraform Drift will remain red until executed, leaving bridge failures temporarily unalarmed with the stale alarm
